name: Patronus
banner: Daily builds for testing. Not for production.
tagline: Patronus is a free, Gentoo-based firewall and router with an SD-WAN dashboard, written in Rust. Pre-1.0.
lead: A Gentoo-based firewall and router with an SD-WAN dashboard, written in Rust and enforced by the kernel's nftables.
what_html:
Patronus is a firewall and router for Gentoo, aimed at the space pfSense and OPNsense occupy. It configures nftables, routing, VPNs and SD-WAN from a web UI and an API. It ships as an ebuild whose USE flags choose what is compiled in.

It is a one-person project in early development. Every claim in its README is tied to a test in CI; features that are not finished are listed without claims.
status: Patronus is pre-1.0. Configuration and on-disk formats can still change between builds. Do not put it in front of a network you cannot afford to lose.
works: Daily ISOs for x86_64 and aarch64: a QEMU test boots, installs (unattended, serial wizard, VGA wizard; UEFI and BIOS on x86_64), reboots from disk and logs in to the web UI.
Nightly live traffic tests of the firewall and SD-WAN paths in network namespaces, and an installer test on a real ZFS root.
A claims ledger: each README claim names the CI tests that prove it, and CI fails if a claim loses its proof.
gaps: No stable release. No in-place upgrade or rollback test of an installed appliance yet.
A bug found on real hardware: the firewall service did not start after a reboot. A fix is in progress; the roadmap keeps this open until CI covers it.
A CPU-specific crash on Intel (fixed on main, not yet confirmed on that machine).
The graphical installer is in progress; today the installer is a text wizard.
Secure Boot is not supported. The automated security audit in the repo is not an independent review.
isos: Server · OpenRC · x86_64 (UEFI + BIOS, hybrid USB/CD)
dl_note: The aarch64 build is tested under QEMU emulation, not on real arm64 hardware.
